transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Where are you going?
Speaker B (Human): I go to home.
Speaker A (AI): You mean, I am going home.
Speaker B (Human): Yes, I am going home. I am very hurry.
Speaker A (AI): I am in a hurry is the correct way.
Speaker B (Human): Okay, I am in a hurry. रुको, तुम इंग्लिश इतनी आसानी से सिखा रही हो, तुम हो कौन? [Wait, you are teaching English so easily, who are you?]
Speaker A (AI): मैं इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप की एआई कोच हूँ। तुमने अभी दो गलतियां की, मैंने 30 सेकंड में सुधार दीं। बिना हँसे, बिना डांटे। यही रोज करते हैं, इंग्लिश आती है। [I am the AI coach of the English Seekho app. You just made two mistakes, I corrected them in 30 seconds. Without laughing, without scolding. Doing this daily brings English.]
Speaker B (Human): सही कह रहे हो। कस्टमर इंग्लिश में कुछ पूछे, मैं चुप हो जाता हूँ। टिप नहीं मिलती। [You're right. If a customer asks something in English, I go quiet. I don't get tips.]
Speaker A (AI): वही सॉल्व करते हैं। रोज 15 मिनट, पिलो पे, अकेले। कोचिंग नहीं, ₹1 का ट्रायल। पहले 15 मिनट करके देखो, पसंद आए तो आगे बढ़ो। [We solve exactly that. Daily 15 minutes, on your pillow, alone. No coaching, a ₹1 trial. Try it for 15 minutes first, if you like it, move forward.]
Speaker B (Human): महंगा तो नहीं? [Is it expensive?]
Speaker A (AI): चाय से भी सस्ता। पर पैसा बाद में। पहले डिसाइड करो, 6 महीने और "I go to home" बोलना है या इस महीने से शुरुआत? [Cheaper than tea. But money later. First decide, do you want to say "I go to home" for another 6 months, or start this month?]
Speaker B (Human): इस महीने। [This month.]
Speaker A (AI): इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप एक्सपर्ट के 2-5 मिनट के वीडियोस हिंदी में समझा के सिखाते हैं। मेरे साथ चैट करके प्रैक्टिस करो। कभी मज़ाक नहीं उड़ाउंगी। 24 घंटे अवेलेबल, जब मन करे। [English Seekho app teaches with 2-5 minute expert videos explained in Hindi. Practice by chatting with me. I will never make fun of you. Available 24 hours, whenever you feel like it.]
Speaker B (Human): सच में? मैं अभी इनस्टॉल करता हूँ इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप। [Really? I will install the English Seekho app right now.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और इंग्लिश सीखो ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]

summary: An AI avatar corrects an auto-rickshaw driver's English grammar mistakes in real-time, demonstrating how the English Seekho app works. The driver explains how his lack of English skills costs him tips from customers, and the AI coach offers a ₹1 trial to practice privately for 15 minutes a day. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
